write.prompt: Much of the plastic in the sea comes from rivers and busy markets. Explain how this waste can harm sea animals, and suggest one way local people can stop it.
write.taskVi: đoạn 110–130 từ (mở rộng: 130–150 từ, không khung) theo chuỗi nguồn rác → tác hại → giải pháp khớp.
mustUse: một cụm phân từ sau danh từ
một mệnh đề V-ing nêu kết quả
write.modelAfterSubmit: Single-use bags thrown into rivers near busy markets are a serious threat to marine life. Carried by the current, these bags soon end up in the sea, where they float like jellyfish. Sea turtles often mistake them for food and swallow them, filling their stomachs with plastic that they cannot digest. Over time, the bags also break into tiny pieces eaten by small fish, allowing plastic to enter the food chain. One effective solution is for market sellers to offer cloth bags instead of free plastic ones. If fewer bags are handed out at the market, fewer will be dropped into the river, and less plastic will reach the sea. Sellers could also give a small discount to customers who bring their own bags.
